inputPlan.scheduleMode: original wall-time schedule; no state polling drives input
inputPlan.resetForDiagnosis: existing resetGame() called after optional ready screenshot; diagnostic only

postCheckpointSampling.reason: source reports used original wall-time schedule; no fixed +120 step wait was executed

startupAlignment.note: Before reset, browser startup simulation progress was not identical. This is a confounder in the original comparison. The paired runs reset to the same default seed/level/ready/progress before the schedule.

observationBoundary.primary: window capture listener records state before the native shell pointerdown handler; window bubble listener records state after the handler returns, before a later frame snapshot.
observationBoundary.inputDisposition: All first-four inputs produced an immediate launch/flip transition at the handler boundary. No buffered-only or ignored input was observed in this paired window; inputBuffer is not asserted when no visible transition occurs.

inputArchitecture.ActionInput: game-core ActionInput owns held/repeat suppression; private held set not observed
inputArchitecture.inputBuffer: SliceSimulation owns inputBuffer after flip cooldown; private value not observed

firstInput.note: first observed timing difference; this is not a complete-state equivalence claim

unobservedFields: remote read and screenshot encoding duration

minimalReverification.result: The earliest observed timing difference is input 1 (109 vs 108 physical steps). The third launch occurs at step 261 without screenshots versus 274 with screenshots, from the same launch pose and velocity. Input 4 is at step 383 in both runs but therefore has 122 versus 109 flight steps; fixed-rule replay produces (435.2,446.75), vy=310 and (418.95,416.4166666667), vy=245. This supports different launch timing as the explanation for the input-4 pre-state difference.
minimalReverification.remainingBoundary: Private ActionInput accepted/buffered state remains unexposed; ActionInput held/repeat and SliceSimulation inputBuffer are not read by this report.
causalLimits: Screenshot waiting, remote reads, event handling and RAF/frame scheduling costs were not independently isolated; screenshot capture is not proven the unique cause.
The supported explanation is different launch timing/physical-step history and its deterministic fixed-update consequence.
